verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own API Changelog records an Anthropic-compatible POST /v1/messages endpoint added in 0.4.1, which directly provides the story's capability on its local server. Support rests on a single changelog entry rather than dedicated endpoint documentation. missing for 10: dedicated endpoint reference docs (request/response fields, streaming, tool use, compatibility limits), independent or hands-on corroboration of Anthropic SDK clients working against it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the server through an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint
